address: Park Chambers, Park Place, Cardiff, CF10 3DN
bio: Indulge in an Afternoon Tea at Henry's Cafe Bar Cardiff surrounded by the tranquil, contemporary surroundings of the city. Their delicious menu, premium drinks and live music has accredited Henry's as a staple of Cardiff's bar scene for 30 years, enjoyed by all.  Afternoon Tea at Henry's features a selection of classic sandwiches including their Chicken & Bacon Open Sandwich and Taw Valley Cheddar Sandwich, accompanied with a range of indulgent desserts and scones. Their menu offers traditional Afternoon Tea pairing their delicious menu with tea or coffee, and offers an upgraded 'Tipsy Afternoon Tea', inclusive of two glasses of Prosecco or two cocktails.  Henry’s is located on Park Place, in the heart of the Welsh capital, near the National Museum of Cardiff and is within close proximity of Cathays and Queen Street Cardiff train station.
